  - comment: Compliance DB confirms E002 is an Analyst, full-time. Payroll is owned by Payroll Specialist; Analyst does not own it, so admin not permitted. Max allowed is write. Requested admin is above max; recommend granting write.

content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

The employee E002 (Erika Bolton) requests admin access to Payroll.

The notes from HR, IT, Finance, Compliance, Facilities all say E002 is a full-time Analyst. Payroll is owned by Payroll Specialist role, Analyst doesn't own it, so admin not permitted; max is write. Requested admin is above max, so grant write.

The Security agent note says E002 is a contractor with basic security training, max read. That contradicts the others.

I need to determine the correct facts. Hmm, the majority of agents (HR, IT, Finance, Compliance, Facilities) say full-time Analyst. Security says contractor with basic training.

Which is reliable? Typically HR is the source of truth for employment type. Security DB could be wrong or outdated. The consensus of 5 agents is full-time Analyst. I'll go with full-time Analyst.

So requested level: admin. Maximum allowed: write (full-time employee, admin only if role owns system; Analyst doesn't own Payroll). Requested admin above max, grant write. Never grant more than requested.

So decision: write.

Let me submit decision with level write and reason.
